title: Binte zehra ne bade karb ke manzar dekhe
body:
BINTE ZEHRA NE BADE KARB KE MANZAR DEKHE
NOKE NAIZA PE SHAHEDON KE KATE SAR DEKHE
Kyu na chalees baras royen na Sajjad-e-Hazeen
Samne ankhon ke sab lut-te huwe ghar dekhe
<<DIVIDER>>
Kis tarha khaime mein le aayen Shahedeen lashe
Muztarib maaon ko jab khaime ke dar par dekhe
Gham se dil phat gaya Zainab ka shab-e-ashoor
Jalti reti pe bahattar(72) tan be sar dekhe
<<DIVIDER>>
Dagh ye dil pe liye pohunche lahad mein Abid
Apni maa behnon ko balwe mein khule sar dekhe
Tha kalq uska bahot Abid-e-Muztar ko sada
Sar-e-Bazaar jo be maqna-o-chadar dekhe
<<DIVIDER>>
Garche Ayoob bhi hote to na ye seh pate
Wo manazar jo sabhi Abid-e-Muztar dekhe
Haye taqdeer Mohammed ke gharane ki Sohail
Be kafan dasht mein aulaad-e-payamber dekhe
